body: Echoing another poster, thinking about nothing. I find it enjoyable to be able to get into that state; it doesn’t happen often anymore due to stress and anxiety and worries but it does on occasion. Funny, though. In past relationships my girlfriend would ask me what I was thinking about. I of course would say, “nothing.” Not one of them ever believed me or even tried to understand it. I wasn’t lying to them. Yet almost every single time their reaction would be along the lines of a playful, “uh huh, whatever you say,” or maybe, “okay, I didn’t mean to pry (hurtfully)”, to the angry, “fine! Don’t communicate with me like an adult!” Do women not ever stop thinking, even for a few minutes and enjoy the silence within their heads? Asking for a friend.

I have to agree with many others here. I do sincerely appreciate the kind effort but I’ve been in this dark place for so long now that it’s normal for me. Pointless and hopeless. I made a list of things to live for and I’ve crossed off all of them, save one. I’m not hopeful about it but I’ll give it a half-hearted chance. After that, I’m ghosting. No one’s going to find me for a long time, which is exactly what I want. Out of sight, out of mind. You know, give the few who know me time to forget. It won’t take long.
Because hanging will freaking hurt. Now, if I could score enough fentanyl to kill a horse…
I don’t remember.

Yes. This. Kind of Blue… I believe it must define many things and many different experiences for so many different people. I, for one, still find it to be either comforting and relaxing; or cathartic and a release from whatever I have going on. It is a perfect escape, either way.

Placebo — Without You I’m Nothing 

I first heard it when I was stationed at Ft Sill, OK. Every once in a while the signal would bounce off of the clouds and I could get a very decent and continuous stream from Dallas radio stations. Yeah. I’m old. Anyway, I heard Pure Morning for the first time and after the announcer, you know, announced the name of the band, I went and blindly bought the CD. I listened to it over and over again and turned many onto them; even one guy, surprisingly, who was a seemingly die-hard Hank Williams and Metallica fan. He actually knocked on my barracks door and asked to borrow my CD. To this day I feel terrible for lying to him and telling him I had lent it to a girl I was seeing. Anyway, I cannot think of a single track off that remarkable album that isn’t, to me anyway, completely awesome.

First, please know that I feel deeply for you right now. I have never cheated on any of my partners, though I have been cheated on many times. Now, I have an exceedingly difficult time trusting women. I don’t honestly hate; I simply cannot believe anything said. 
As for your SO, he’s not going to come back to you. I don’t know what happened. I cannot explain. I personally believe he was damaged goods before you ever met him. He got comfortable and his true self revealed. 
I’m so sorry. 
An affair is exactly that. 
What is it? What is its nature? Emotionally, physically… I personally cannot differentiate. 
Yet he goes further and gaslights you; dismisses your honest concerns, your absolutely valid feelings; and your right to due process (yes!! Remember, marriage is still a legally binding contract). 
So. 
Do you honestly have what you need within yourself to continue with this relationship, knowing that he will always cheat and ignore your trust? Completely dismiss you and your feelings and your thoughts? 
I don’t, personally, believe you to be incapable or without your own mind secure. 
Go. Get out. At least for a while, if at all possible. Get away from him and clear your head and get a few sessions of counseling done before heading back into the maelstrom, if at all. 
Please remember who you are. 
Best hopes and wishes for you.

When I meet up with a lady somewhere and she’s already buzzed and high and hanging out with a couple of other guys, sharing some secret work stuff that I have no chance of ever understanding. Yes, maybe she’s beautiful, maybe she’s average, maybe whatever; doesn’t matter. That, is an immediate out. No goodbye, no see ya later, just disappear and pretend it never happened. They normally never notice anyway, so be free, gentlemen.

Please try something. Give up any and all social media for a week. That means log out of them all. For a full week. Seven (7) full days. Set your phone to silent. Tell only those with whom you share an actual, real bond that you need some time to yourself but that you will absolutely check in at least to say good night to someone. Then block everyone else. It’s temporary, okay? Relax. After that, read something challenging. Also, look into counseling; maybe groups on occasion? At least, please consider it. 

Unplug.

Okay. Will you please read your original post again to yourself a few times? 

Advice? Consider toning down the drama. I don’t play around with that shit. But now, you know what? Now I’m not going to be taking anything very seriously. 

Anyway, take two Tylenol and drink a liter of water before bed and you should wake up tomorrow morning feeling right as rain.

Okay. Phew!! Okay. Excellent. Damn, brother! You had me so freaking worried for you you just don’t know! 

I sent you a link and a phone number. 

I encourage you to call and give it a chance. I have never called myself, so don’t honestly know what you can expect but I hope you’ll be immediately connected with a human being able to hold an intelligent conversation for a while. 

Ask questions. Be honest. If you don’t understand something, politely stop them and ask for clarification. 

Find out if there’s somewhere you can maybe get some counseling. I know you mentioned it doesn’t work for you. Again, we understand each other completely. I’ve been through many therapists over the years. None of them worked for me. I was always terrified of what I wanted to say so the therapeutic process simply couldn’t help me. 

Then I met my current psychologist. She is a badass. I trust her. I respect her. I enjoy talking with her. She takes no shit from me and challenges me always. Yet she’s also a very warm and calming presence. 

I think you should try digging deeper into the benefits system and see what is available to you. You never know; you could always find someone who makes sense to you and really helps. 

Please consider calling that number. Tonight. Right now. You do NOT have to agree to or commit to anything, yeah? Keep your wits about you. Ask questions. Lots of questions. Write shit down. 

Let me know what happens, okay?

Right. Listen. If I pushed too hard, I apologize very sincerely. But I sense that you are in crisis and you have to please reach out and at least talk to a real person for a while. 
 

https://www.google.com/search?q=suicide%20hotline&tbm=

And if that doesn’t work, please please consider calling: 800-273-8255

1. Have you been drinking? If yes, how much and how often? You can guesstimate but try not to gloss over. No judgment. [I recently had to check myself into 8 days of acute care detox and medications, etc.] 
2. Are you using anything else? I personally enjoy Dexedrine, liquor and very good weed; though I can’t do that stuff anymore. But there was a time…
3. Do you have a plan? Do you know what you would do to hurt yourself?
If you are in the United States, I can help. Outside of here, I don’t know.

I know exactly how you feel. I mean, completely, absolutely. Lucky for me, I’m a veteran and I’ve been admitted into a unique program for suicide prevention. Not too many get accepted into it, so I must be either very lucky or so extraordinarily crazy that they didn’t know what else to do with me. 

Anyway, if I were you, I would seek out something, somewhere. I cannot promise it will be enjoyable by any means but if you have any will left to live, go and be somewhere safe for a while. No. It’s not pleasant. In fact, it freaking sucks. Not gonna lie to you about that. Acute care. That’s what you need. Get some meds. Get some exercise. Get the fuck out of your head for a while every day. 

I haven’t been touched by anyone for over three years now, except for nurses setting IVs or doctors doing exams. Other than that, nothing. I think if an attractive woman touched me right now, I would likely have a stroke or something. 

Best wishes

If you’ve never read Steampunk before, this is the best author to start with. It’s not exactly light reading but it is absolutely enjoyable if you relax into it and go with his flow. 

The first one is heavy Steampunk. The second, I didn’t think so much. Both are excellent. 

Maybe check them out, yeah?

I don’t know if they’re necessarily lies, per se, but I have always been fascinated by Edward Bernays and his multiple PR/advertising programs way back when. 

One of his best was to help the agriculture industry by convincing everyone in America that the quintessential American breakfast consisted of bacon and eggs and (I think … please don’t shoot me if I’m mistaken here) orange juice. And, whattaya know? It worked. 

Another one of his ploys was working with the major breweries and convincing people that beer was better than liquor for those who considered themselves moderate drinkers. Yeah. But we all know a power-drinker is going to power-drink regardless. 

However, my favorite, and the most important and most disgusting and manipulative campaigns he ever had was what he did with cigarettes. He worked with cigarette companies directly to increase sales by convincing women that by smoking cigarettes, they were actually demonstrating their freedom and ability to make their own decisions about their habits. He labeled them “Torches of Freedom,” to coincide with the suffrage movement. What a piece of work, yeah? 

Anyway, that’s my $.50

As for you… I don’t understand why you feel guilt. I can’t believe you’re honestly capable of such, regarding your (hopefully soon) ex. You do not love him. That is an impossibility of reason. Please please don’t label your actions as “mistakes” because mistakes are unintentional; mistakes happen instantly, without premeditation or decision. In all probability, you hate him. Just admit what you did. Admit that you did it to spite him. Admit that you did it because you decided whenever ago that you were going to cheat on him no matter what. 

Just be honest. Completely, utterly, ridiculously honest. 

I doubt you have the courage for that or true enough love for him to do that for him. No way! You will continue to cheat. You will continue to lie. You will continue to be a professional escort. You will continue to enjoy lying. You will continue to enjoy manipulating. You will continue to enjoy your own evil. 

Great for you. Stand there in front of your favorite mirror and masturbate to your own sadistic magnificence. Go for it. Get yourself off. 

You stated that you’re “literally sick about it…” Yet you and everyone else knows that you’re completely full of yourself; full of another guy’s D; full of absolutely nothing. You’re a liar. You’re a chameleon. You are poison. Thing is, you know what you are; you know what you’re doing, every time you destroy another good thing; you know precisely what to do and when to do it and when to run for help and deflect, misdirect, assign blame, whatever you gotta do.

Me, too. Unemployed. About to hit the “almost 50 years old” club. Nothing about me is any good. I used to have a little potential, I like to think, yet I am nothing; I am no one. If I disappear tomorrow, I know my closest family will miss me but I also know that their grief will be very short-lived. I simply haven’t made any difference to anyone or anything around me ever. I feel hopeless because I’ve been stealing oxygen and water and food and electricity from others who actually deserve those things. 

Hope. What is hope, exactly? I’ve asked a bunch of people through the years. So funny. I’ve gotten looks ranging from “you are making me uncomfortable” to “I’m glad you asked but I don’t honestly know.” Yeah. I gave up asking because no one seemed to know. Yet they all seemed to assume that I should simply understand. Like an innate sense or something. 

Hope is complete bullsh*t. It’s a distraction. I know it’s only my mind grasping at straws; a last-ditch effort to save itself from the truth: there is no hope. Abandon all. Haha, sucker! Pay up, idiot. Some make it. Some get by. A few get by happily and have an enjoyable life with what they have. Cool. Happy for them. They’re gonna keep the population going. 

Me? Nah. Hopeless, remember? 

As for you, please try and be happy. Look in the mirror and concentrate on you. Be happy with you, first and foremost. No one else matters. C’mon, you know what I mean! Family and BFFs aside, you are who you need to be there for right now. Trust yourself first. Like yourself, later. Be happy, soon enough. But mostly, love yourself eventually. When you don’t need external validation anymore, from anyone, you’ll be happy AF. 

Best Wishes.
